description: Take over a queued or orphaned job (its runner died) and drive it on from where it was recorded. Waits up to waitSec like run_job. A job that already ended is returned as it ended.

waitSec.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end before answering (default 45, at most 600). A job still running then goes on; poll job_status.

name: resume_job
